page.title: What your rules did
page.intro: Every event a rule added, updated, removed, skipped, or blocked, and why. Events are named as each run found them.

message.sessionExpired: Your administrator session has expired. Sign in again to view operational activity.
message.applicationUpdated: Calendar Ghost was updated. Reload the page to continue.
message.serviceError: The local service returned an error; try the request again.
message.unreachable: The request did not reach the local service. It may have been restarting, or a browser extension such as a content blocker may be blocking it; try the request again.

history.title: History
history.intro: Newest first. Select an entry to see what happened and why.
history.caption: Synchronization history, newest first

quiet.title: Nothing has changed yet
quiet.body: No rule has added, updated, removed, skipped, or blocked an event. Checks that found everything already up to date are hidden.

search.title: No events named “{query}”
search.body: Search matches event titles as each run recorded them. Check the spelling, show all decisions, or clear the search.

filtered.title: No matching activity
filtered.body: No recorded decisions match these filters. Show all decisions, or choose a different rule.

none.title: No activity yet
none.body: Synchronization decisions will appear here after an enabled rule completes its first run.

cell.recordedBefore: Recorded before event names were kept

reason.recheck: Nothing to do now. Calendar Ghost decides this event again at the daily check, and opens an incident if it is still blocked then.

unknown.explanation: This version of Calendar Ghost cannot describe this entry yet. Its recorded detail is below.

reason.unchangedBySourceChange: The event changed in {source}, and {destination} already matched it, so nothing was written for this entry.

sourceCreated.explanation: The event was new to Calendar Ghost, so it was added to {destination}.

projectionMissing.explanation: The event Calendar Ghost wrote to {destination} was no longer there, so it was written again from {source}.

sourceChanged.explanation: The event changed in {source}, so {destination} was updated to match.

destinationDriftRepaired.explanation: The event in {destination} no longer matched {source}. {source} decides what the event looks like, so the edit was replaced.

sourceCancelled.explanation: The event was cancelled or deleted in {source}, so it was removed from {destination}.

allDayExcludedRemoved.trigger: All-day, which this rule leaves out
allDayExcludedRemoved.explanation: This rule syncs timed events only, so the all-day event it had written was removed.

declinedRemoved.explanation: You declined this event in {source}, so the event Calendar Ghost had written was removed. Declined events are never synced.

tentativeExcludedRemoved.trigger: Answered Maybe, which this rule leaves out
tentativeExcludedRemoved.explanation: This rule doesn't sync events you answered Maybe to, so the event it had written was removed.

awaitingResponseRemoved.explanation: This rule waits for you to answer an invitation before syncing it, so the event it had written was removed. It is added again once you accept, or answer Maybe if this rule syncs those.

policyApplied.explanation: The rule's settings changed, so the event it had written was rewritten to match them.

outsideSourceCalendar.explanation: The event does not belong to {source}.

managedProjectionSource.explanation: Events Calendar Ghost wrote are never synced again. This prevents events from looping between calendars.

recurringUnsupported.explanation: Earlier versions did not sync recurring events. Nothing was written.

cancelledWithoutProjection.explanation: The event was cancelled before it was ever added to {destination}.

allDayExcluded.explanation: This rule syncs timed events only. Edit the rule to include all-day events.

declined.explanation: You declined this event in {source}. Declined events are never synced.

tentativeExcluded.explanation: This rule doesn't sync events you answered Maybe to. Edit the rule to sync them.

awaitingResponse.explanation: This rule waits for you to answer an invitation before syncing it. It is synced once you accept, or answer Maybe if this rule syncs those.

beforeSyncWindow.explanation: The event changed, but it ended before this rule's sync window and was never synced, so it was not added.

mappingInconsistent.trigger: Calendar Ghost's link to this event doesn't match
mappingInconsistent.explanation: Calendar Ghost keeps a record of which event in {destination} belongs to which event in {source}. For this event the record points somewhere unexpected, so nothing was written rather than risk changing the wrong event.

destinationIdentityInconsistent.trigger: A different event is linked in {destination}
destinationIdentityInconsistent.explanation: The event in {destination} is no longer the one Calendar Ghost wrote for this event, so nothing was written rather than risk changing the wrong event.

destinationOwnershipInconsistent.trigger: Not marked as written by this rule in {destination}
destinationOwnershipInconsistent.explanation: The event in {destination} does not carry this rule's marker, so Calendar Ghost will not change or delete it.

sourceUnverifiable.explanation: Its source event in {source} could not be read, so the event in {destination} was left as it is rather than risk deleting it.
sourceUnverifiable.next: If this repeats, check in Settings that the calendar account for {source} is still connected.

occurrenceChanged.explanation: This occurrence was moved or edited in {source}, so it was updated in {destination}. The rest of the series is unchanged.

occurrenceCancelled.explanation: This occurrence was cancelled in {source}, so it was removed from {destination}. The rest of the series is unchanged.

occurrenceRemovedFromSeries.trigger: No longer in the series in {source}
occurrenceRemovedFromSeries.explanation: The series in {source} no longer includes this occurrence, so it was removed from {destination}.

occurrenceDriftRepaired.explanation: This occurrence in {destination} no longer matched {source}. {source} decides what the event looks like, so it was restored.

occurrenceAlreadyCancelled.explanation: This occurrence is cancelled in both calendars.

occurrenceRetired.explanation: The occurrence no longer exists in either calendar, so its record was removed. Nothing was written.

seriesNotSynchronized.explanation: This occurrence belongs to a recurring event this rule does not sync.

destinationOccurrenceMissing.trigger: Not found in the series in {destination}
destinationOccurrenceMissing.explanation: The series in {destination} has no occurrence at this time, even after Calendar Ghost checked the series itself. Nothing was written, so this occurrence may be missing or out of date in {destination}. The rest of the series is unaffected.

seriesWithoutOccurrences.explanation: Every occurrence of this recurring event is cancelled in {source}, or is an all-day occurrence this rule leaves out, so there is nothing to show in {destination}. It is synced again if an occurrence comes back.

seriesWithoutOccurrencesRemoved.explanation: Every occurrence of this recurring event is cancelled in {source}, or is an all-day occurrence this rule leaves out, so the series left from an interrupted run was removed.

projectionUnmapped.trigger: Marked as written by this rule in {destination}, but not linked to an event in {source}
projectionUnmapped.explanation: The event in {destination} carries this rule's marker, but Calendar Ghost has no record of writing it, so it will not change or delete it. Reconcile now reports it again while it is there.
projectionUnmapped.next: If you don't want it in {destination}, delete it there yourself.

projectionUnsupported.explanation: The calendar service of {destination} has no way to show this event exactly as it is in {source}, such as a recurrence it cannot repeat or an occurrence it cannot bring back. Calendar Ghost never shows an approximation, so nothing was written for it. The rest of the rule keeps syncing.
projectionUnsupported.next: To show it in {destination}, change its recurrence in {source} to a simpler one, or add it to {destination} yourself.

policyChanged.explanation: The rule needs a new preview, and the events it wrote are rewritten on the next run after it is enabled.

removeProjection.explanation: The administrator chose to delete the events this rule wrote when removing it.

detachProjection.explanation: The event stays in {destination} and is no longer updated or deleted.

removalConflict.trigger: Not verifiably written by this rule
removalConflict.explanation: The event's ownership could not be verified, so it was not deleted. It stays in {destination} and is no longer managed.

ruleRemoved.explanation: The rule and its records of which events it wrote were removed. Its activity history is kept.

lookup.removedRule: This rule was removed, so its events can no longer be looked up.
lookup.notConfigured: Its calendar provider is not configured, so the event cannot be looked up.
lookup.failed: Its calendar provider could not return this event right now. The account may need reauthorization in Settings.
lookup.missing: No longer exists in its calendar.

detail.label: Entry details
detail.missing: This entry is no longer in the activity history.

changes.heading: What changed in {source}
changes.failed: What changed could not be loaded right now.
changes.valuesUnavailable: Some values are no longer available. They are kept for 90 days, and cannot be read after the installation master key changes.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.intro: Each stays open until Calendar Ghost confirms the problem is gone.

guidance.accessRenewed: Calendar access is renewed, but the rule stays stopped until it is recovered.
guidance.authorization: Nothing is written until the calendar account is reauthorized. Existing events stay where they are.
guidance.stopped: The rule is stopped and writes nothing until it is recovered.
guidance.retrying: Nothing to do now. Calendar Ghost keeps retrying and closes this after the next successful sync.
guidance.conflict: The rest of the rule keeps syncing. This closes when a daily check finds nothing still blocked.

resolution.blocksCleared: Resolved when the daily check found nothing still blocked.
resolution.ruleRemoved: Closed when the rule was removed.
resolution.accessRestored: Resolved when the calendar provider accepted the account again.
